text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, thank you! I dunno why, but I feel 
like I've grown a whole size bigger.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if your looks don't change, 
what's inside is what truly counts! Keep 
training hard so you can grow into a grand 
horse girl like Lady Inari.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's this, what's this? Suddenly 
acting all big-sisterly, are we?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, I really am your big sister. My 
birthday's a little bit earlier than 
yours, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's that, it's really only a tiny bit?! 
That's just—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, fighting is out of the question. 
Especially on such a wonderful birthday.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. I should stop making 
snide remarks and just celebrate properly 
with an open heart.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there♪ You both made up, such good 
girls~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo & Inari
text_block_list.text: Shut the hell up!! Pipe down, will ya?!
